problems.title: Cadet Workstation Matrix Shift
problems.description: Given an M x N 2D grid of cadet seat numbers and an integer k, shift the grid elements cyclically by k positions. Element at grid[i][j] moves to grid[i][j + 1], element at grid[i][n - 1] moves to grid[i + 1][0], and element at grid[m - 1][n - 1] moves to grid[0][0]. Return the shifted 2D grid.

sample_testcases.explanation: Every element shifts right by 1 position cyclically.

problems.title: Medi-Caps Secure Subnet Partitions
problems.description: Given an integer array traffic representing packet counts on consecutive subnets and an integer k, return the number of non-empty subarrays with sum divisible by k.
problems.output_format: Return an integer count of valid subarrays.

sample_testcases.explanation: There are 7 subarrays with sum divisible by 5.

problems.title: Server Rack Heat Dissipation Tree
problems.description: You are given a tree with n server nodes labeled 0 to n - 1 rooted at node 0. Each node has heat output values[i]. You can place at most c independent cooling units such that no two cooled nodes are directly connected. Maximize the total heat mitigated by the cooled nodes.

problems.title: Air-Gapped Cryptographic Signature DAG
problems.description: Given a directed acyclic graph of n certificate authorities with directed edges [[u, v, reliability], ...], find the path from authority 0 to authority n - 1 that visits at least k intermediate nodes with the maximum cumulative reliability score. If no such path exists, return -1.
problems.output_format: Return maximum path reliability score or -1.

sample_testcases.explanation: Path 0 -> 1 -> 3 has 1 intermediate node and score 10 + 20 = 30.
